baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural sign noun, singular book noun, and qualifying adjective in 31:2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each perceptible sign is a unit; joining makes the units one book, and perfecting locks their relations into a dependable whole.

activation_trace.role: A publicly detectable mark supplies each readable unit.
Physical joining supplies the assembly operation that turns plural units into one book.
Making a thing firm and finished supplies the reliability constraint on the assembly.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that these are verses of a wise book.
changed_reading.after: These are discrete, inspectable signs whose relations have been joined and secured as one coherent system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The book-wisdom construction can describe what the sign-units do, not only praise their style.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book fixes determinations; its governing quality blocks disorder and supplies adjudication. The signs function as operative notices of a repairing order.

activation_trace.role: A manifest indicator gives each determination an inspectable notice.
Fixing an obligation or decree gives the book operative force.
Restraint that turns back damage makes the force corrective rather than arbitrary.
Adjudication supplies a social mechanism for settling conflict.

changed_reading.before: Wisdom is an abstract excellence of the text.
changed_reading.after: The book is wise by fixing, restraining, repairing, and judging through its signs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The signs, book, and governing adjective can be read as an address-register-jurisdiction sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sign can be deliberately targeted, a name can be entered into a register, and judgment can be entrusted; together they suggest individuated address under jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Deliberately aiming at a person's identifying sign supplies targeted address.
Entering a name into a roll supplies individuation and record membership.
Entrusting a matter to an arbiter supplies the jurisdiction governing that record.

changed_reading.before: The verse addresses an undifferentiated audience about a book.
changed_reading.after: Its signs may also address, index, and place persons under an entrusted judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The book's restraint becomes a beneficent feedback process: it gently orients, sets conduct upright, and yields settled cognition.

activation_trace.role: Corrective restraint supplies the regulating action at the focus.
Gentle wayfinding turns regulation into directed correction.
Tender concern supplies the beneficial aim of the correction.
Restoring balance and uprightness supplies the practiced adjustment.
Knowledge becoming stable and doubt receding supplies the feedback outcome.

structural_cues: 31:3 predicates guidance and mercy immediately after the focus, while 31:4-5 move through repeated practices to an announced outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, care, upright establishment, and certainty; I infer a loop from sign to practice to stable orientation. They could instead be reader-effects without describing the book's own mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The binding book mainly restrains misconduct.
changed_reading.after: Its binding force is calibrated guidance: it repairs orientation through practice until understanding settles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The written signs enter time as sequenced recitation and compete with purchased novelty for attention; rejection occurs by interrupting the path from hearing to compliance.

activation_trace.role: Organized writing supplies the stable message that later enters recitation.
Being occupied by a substitute supplies the rival attention channel.
Freshly renewed talk supplies the rival channel's recurrent novelty.
One item following another supplies temporal delivery of the book's signs.
The repeated manifest marks identify what is being delivered in sequence.
Deliberate turning away supplies an active break in reception.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the blocked downstream function.
Imagined auditory weight materializes the self-imposed blockage.

structural_cues: 31:6 sets acquired distracting discourse against 31:7's recited signs; the repeated 'as if' marks simulated non-hearing rather than absent sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two transmissions, sequential delivery, turning, and obstructed understanding; I infer competition for an attention-to-action channel. The contrast could be ethical rather than a model of reception.

changed_reading.before: The signs are stable propositions stored in a book.
changed_reading.after: They are a live transmission whose efficacy depends on attention, sequencing, and willingness to let hearing become response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation, support, anchoring against oscillation, distribution, and growth instantiate the focus model at world-scale: many operations cohere as one stabilized specification.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the architecture that relates distinct operations.
Firm finishing supplies system integrity at the focus.
Measurement and proportion supply the specification step.
Load-bearing support supplies the otherwise unseen structural problem.
Fixing something in place supplies stabilization.
Swaying and instability specify what the stabilizer prevents.
Dispersion supplies distributed population of the system.
Emergence from the ground supplies productive output after delivery of water.

structural_cues: 31:10 explicitly links the anchors to prevention of swaying, then sequences scattering, descent, and growth; 31:11 turns the result into a demonstrative challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured parts, failure mode, stabilizer, distribution, and output; I infer a control architecture and read it back into the assembled book. The context may only offer evidence of a maker, not identify creation with a book.

changed_reading.before: The book is coherent because its textual units are well joined.
changed_reading.after: Its coherence becomes a control diagram for reading measured creation: supports, anchors, flows, populations, and growth form one governed order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wisdom is delivered, made visible in grateful response, carried through intimate counsel and inherited charge, then compiled into positive commands and limits.

activation_trace.role: Accurate practical understanding supplies the focus quality to be transferred.
Giving supplies transfer rather than merely innate possession.
The repeated wisdom root names what is transferred into a human recipient.
A small input whose effect becomes evident supplies the first observable output of wisdom.
A warning that softens reception supplies the affective mode of transmission.
A charge connected onward to another supplies intergenerational continuity.
Binding direction supplies the positive side of practical wisdom.
Active prevention supplies its limiting side.

structural_cues: 31:12 repeats the focus root as the object given to Luqman; 31:13-19 unfolds it through repeated intimate address and imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, visible response, counsel, transmitted charge, commands, and prohibitions; I infer that the wise book reproduces practical judgment in readers. Luqman's sequence could exemplify wisdom without defining the adjective in 31:2.

changed_reading.before: Wisdom is a static property possessed by the book.
changed_reading.after: The wise book is a transfer protocol: it produces practical judgment that can be voiced, inherited, and enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed individual record can resolve sub-perceptual acts, guarantees eventual settlement, and refuses substitution between even the closest persons.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register supplies individual indexing.
Fair settlement supplies the record's eventual use.
A declared future that opens expectation supplies commitment to settlement.
Stable correspondence with reality makes the commitment dependable.
Exact weight supplies quantitative resolution at tiny scale.
The minute seed supplies the record's lower bound of detectability.
Subtle smallness and concealment supply the retrieval challenge.
One party standing in for another supplies the substitution operation that the verse twice blocks.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the tiny object inside rock, sky, or earth before retrieval; 31:33 twice negates parent-child substitution and repeats that the promise is real.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies indexing, minute measurement, hidden retrieval, guaranteed outcome, and blocked substitution; I infer a granular non-transferable ledger. The passages could describe omniscience and accountability without specifying record mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The exploratory register model merely classifies addressed persons.
changed_reading.after: The book reads as a person-indexed account whose smallest entries remain retrievable and whose settlement cannot be transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs become interfaces to hidden conditions; an illuminating book guides across that boundary and untangles discourse that otherwise coils around itself without knowledge.

activation_trace.role: An outwardly detectable mark supplies the visible interface.
Exposure supplies the readable surface of bestowed conditions.
A concealed interior supplies depth that the surface alone does not exhaust.
Twisted contention supplies the interpretive knot produced without orientation.
Gentle direction supplies movement through the surface-depth problem.
An organized written artifact supplies the mediating instrument.
Illumination supplies disclosure without erasing the distinction between exterior and interior.

structural_cues: 31:20 pairs apparent and hidden benefits, then denies knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating book to the disputant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surface, interior, tangled dispute, direction, writing, and light; I infer an epistemic interface that makes hidden relations navigable. The final three nouns may be parallel authorities rather than one pipeline.

changed_reading.before: A sign is valuable because it is already obvious.
changed_reading.after: A sign is a lit surface through which the book guides toward relations that remain hidden from unaided dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding instruction becomes a reciprocal attachment: yielding one's direction enables a firm grip, and the grip carries action toward its outcome.

activation_trace.role: A fixed obligation supplies the covenantal side of the attachment.
Structural firmness supplies confidence that the attachment will hold.
Handing something over supplies the reader's relinquishing movement.
Holding fast supplies active uptake rather than passive assent.
Tight security supplies the attachment's load-bearing quality.
The terminal consequence supplies the direction in which the grip carries the reader.

structural_cues: The branchless root ع ر و at 31:22.10 supplies the literal handle construction only and is not branch-cited; surrender, grasp, firmness, and outcome form one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relinquishment, grasp, security, a branchless handle noun, and consequence; I infer that the wise book is relationally held. The handle may denote commitment generally rather than the book specifically.

changed_reading.before: The book imposes a decree externally on its reader.
changed_reading.after: Its binding wisdom also becomes a secure relation that the reader must yield to and actively grip.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every physical writing resource can be multiplied and replenished yet exhausted, while meaningful speech continues; the perfected book is therefore a bounded inscription that opens onto an unbounded source.

activation_trace.role: The written artifact supplies the finite container tested by the later counterfactual.
Material trunks supply a massively multiplied writing resource.
A prepared writing reed converts that material into inscription capacity.
Vast water supplies the scale of the writing medium.
Replenishing a pen from an ink supply gives the medium a continuation mechanism.
Running out supplies the hard limit on every accumulated medium.
Meaningful speech exchanged between parties supplies what exceeds inscription capacity.
The repeated quality of firm completion closes the contrast without making the finite artifact exhaustive.

structural_cues: 31:27 expands trees to pens and one sea to seven replenishing seas, then negates exhaustion only of the divine words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing tools, scalable medium, replenishment, exhaustion, and unexhausted speech; I infer a boundary between the focus book and its source. The verse may assert infinitude without commenting directly on the book's boundedness.

changed_reading.before: The joined book appears to contain the relevant whole.
changed_reading.after: The perfected book is a finite aperture: its signs truly mediate, but they do not exhaust the speech from which they come.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs become event-bearings in motion: transit exposes them, interlocking waves intensify their legibility, rescue tests whether that reading persists, and knowledgeable denial can erase it after stability returns.

activation_trace.role: A detectable indicator supplies the navigational bearing at the focus.
A vessel moving through water supplies the carrier under changing conditions.
Ongoing flow supplies motion in which signs must be read dynamically.
The doubled manifest-sign occurrence explicitly identifies voyage phenomena as readable bearings.
Interpenetrating turbulence supplies the crisis that raises signal salience.
Escape by separation supplies the transition back to safety.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the post-rescue failure to retain the reading.

structural_cues: 31:31 repeats the sign root around the voyage and qualifies the receptive reader; 31:32 sequences engulfment, sincere appeal, rescue, moderation, and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel, flow, repeated signs, turbulence, separation, and informed denial; I infer navigation and retention stages. The voyage can remain an example of signs rather than a model for how all signs operate.

changed_reading.before: A sign is a static mark available equally in every condition.
changed_reading.after: A sign can be a moving bearing whose force rises under instability and whose retention is morally contestable after rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wise sign-system distinguishes disclosed knowledge from variables no human self can close in advance, calibrating agency without granting predictive possession.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge that reaches the right result supplies the focus model of wisdom.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the positive side of the boundary.
Acquired knowing supplies the human capacity explicitly negated in two cases.
The individual self supplies the bounded epistemic subject.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the uncertain content of tomorrow's agency.
The next day supplies the near future that still resists possession.
Loss of life supplies the terminal event whose place remains unknown.
Knowledge of inner conditions supplies the closing contrast with bounded selves.

structural_cues: 31:34 alternates divine knowing with two parallel clauses in which no self knows, spanning time, acquisition, place, and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive divine knowledge and repeated human non-knowledge; I infer that wise signs teach where prediction must stop. The list could exalt divine knowledge without defining a pedagogy of limits.

changed_reading.before: A wise book is expected to supply answers and remove uncertainty.
changed_reading.after: Its wisdom also marks the boundary of answerability, directing action while refusing human ownership of future variables.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant ه د د target for 31:3's guidance root. It remains anchored through the immediate guidance predicate and 31:2's corrective adjective, but downstream prose should label breaking and soothing as experimental sound/form activations, not lexical glosses of guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The corrective governing quality in 31:2, activated by the immediate guidance predicate in 31:3.

activation_trace.role: Turning back damage supplies the focus-side function that guidance may perform.
Gentle wayfinding supplies the ordinary regulating mode.
Forceful breaking supplies an alternative mode that disrupts a resistant structure.
Rhythmic calming of a child supplies the opposite mode, lowering resistance to reception.

changed_reading.before: Guidance changes a reader only by supplying correct semantic direction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wise signs may also modulate receptivity by breaking a resistant pattern or calming the reader into attention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a concrete tack image is transferred to textual wisdom. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and is activated by explicit regulation of cheek, gait, and voice in 31:18-19; render it only as a material analogy for self-governance, never as the adjective's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The concrete restraint branch of the adjective in 31:2.

activation_trace.role: Tack surrounding an animal's jaw supplies a material control interface for the focus adjective.
A proud deviation of cheek and neck supplies the bodily trajectory needing correction.
Keeping between extremes supplies calibrated gait control.
Reducing output supplies calibrated voice control.

changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the wise book is also a bridle-like discipline that governs bodily direction and expressive force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a creation-and-resurrection comparison is mapped onto the focus verse's number grammar. It remains anchored in plural signs joined to one book, but downstream prose should present unified execution as a structural analogy, not identify the book with creation or resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Plural signs governed by a singular book in 31:2.

activation_trace.role: Multiple detectable marks supply the many units.
Joining supplies their singular organization.
Arousing what was still supplies a complex operation applied across many subjects.
Unifying distinct things in one respect supplies the compression rule.

changed_reading.before: The book is one because many sign-pieces are physically compiled.
changed_reading.after: The many signs may also be one at the level of execution: distinct units participate in a single governed operation.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a praised text to a perfected control architecture that assembles signs, stabilizes systems, and regulates practice.
The register reading became a granular non-transferable account with dependable settlement.
The finite writing apparatus of 31:27 prevented the coherent book from being mistaken for an exhaustive container of divine speech.
Recitation and voyage contexts made signs events in attention and motion, while 31:34 made epistemic limits part of wisdom.
summary.what_was_special: The same three focus roots sustained textual, juridical, engineering, pedagogical, archival, navigational, and epistemic readings without forcing a final choice; the split guidance target and concrete bridle branch preserved the strangest live activations under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Cosmic and maritime mechanisms may be analogies activated by the context rather than extensions of the book noun itself.
The later repetitions of the wisdom root qualify different grammatical subjects, so they sharpen but do not settle the focus adjective's branch.
The form-distant ه د د target and bridle image should remain exploratory even though both visibly change the focus reading.
